decisions.reason: Although conferencing is adjacent to the firm's communications capabilities, it is less tied to its distinctive infrastructure strengths and, with no visible later evidence, management would likely redeploy resources to more core software-defined connectivity services.

A metropolitan data centre connection network sits squarely in the firm's fibre, metro and data-centre knowledge base and already showed adoption, so absorptive capacity strongly favours retaining it.
Optical spectrum connectivity directly leverages the firm's owned fibre assets, engineering expertise and move toward high-bandwidth infrastructure, making withdrawal unlikely.

The voice number ordering portal fits existing voice and provisioning know-how and supports digital automation of service operations, so it is still worth keeping despite some risk from legacy voice market pressure.
